title: Ulyana and the Inheritance
author: Ines Okafor
blurb: Jude Reyes, a hotel concierge who notices everything, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the trial begins.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
